source.title: GatherBuffs source-level loot-window action-count and saved session audit (Git blob c17312646ed71c179c67a8229af283235381dcdb)
source.author: barnpusher

notes: NEW distinct original-source capture-path evaluation, NOT player drop evidence. Source `Modules/Profit.lua` pinned Git blob c17312646ed71c179c67a8229af283235381dcdb checked Nov 16 UTC. Release v0.99.19 dated Apr 22, 2026 advertises loot-window/current-cast tracking and per-profession gather-action counts for Midnight 12.0.5, but source does NOT provide an unconditional completed-Disenchant counter. `HandleLootItem` marks an action only when a positive material item is recognized as a tracked gather output and `countsForProfit` is true (lines 1618-1644); `MarkLootWindowProfessions` requires an active loot window (439-448); `FinalizeLootWindow` increments profession totals once per resulting profession set (450-486). Secret-payload fallback `ProcessInventoryLootDelta` counts only positive tracked item deltas (1674-1709). `SaveSessionState` persists aggregate `session.gatherCounts` and output `session.loot` by base itemID, without per-cast outcomes, input bonus/actual item level, skill, spec, output rank or observed patch. Thus zero-result or filtered disenchants are uncounted; an action count is NOT a 0-inclusive item-specific denominator, and output total quantities do not supply per-cast histogram. `IsEnchantingTrackingBlocked` (409-437) can also suppress tracking without Shattered Essence buff. This source yields zero new observed casts, hits, totals, zeros, ranks or gold values; cannot validate 272246 ilvl305 or 237362, 237359, 237365, 236761 numeric baselines. No original player SavedVariables or successful cast ledger discovered. Release: https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/gatherbuffs/files/7967869. Do not treat addon design or synthetic examples as measured studies.
lookingFor: New 12.1.5 raw 0-inclusive observed completed-cast data for Miststalker's Wristbands 272246 disenchant, Umbral Tin Ore 237362 / Refulgent Copper Ore 237359 / Brilliant Silver Ore 237365 prospecting and Tranquility Bloom 236761 milling; evaluate a distinct addon tracking independent denominators.
